assessment: Equality with owner-grouped concatenation is an appropriate conservative acceptance predicate: it preserves within-owner order and rejects interleaved groups instead of silently changing a complete submitted candidate. CheckedModule separately validates owner existence and unique signature IDs.

Flat expression registry order need not survive source round-trip; ordered roots/child slots/arguments retain syntactic order, so removing registry storage order from presentation equivalence is coherent.

OrderRequired applies only to fresh accepted and unknown-applied-success artifacts; replay, changed-byte collision and unauthorized denial remain independent of candidate order and parser/decoder availability. The explicit unordered replay/collision witnesses cover that boundary.

GuardedStep and GuardedAdmittedStep conjoin the presentation requirement to original transitions rather than replacing original type/authorization/CAS requirements. Original237 claims remain unchanged; imported Allow.Document hash equals reviewed r5 source.
TEXT_ONLY remains exempt from invented field structure. History-copy is a fresh success and therefore must validate ordering; replay of an old receipt remains historical outcome recovery.
explicit_model_limit: The14 propositions establish the acceptance-order guard and retained early outcomes, not a total decision procedure or a new theorem that every order-only failure creates an INVALID_DRAFT receipt. Runtime deterministic denial/receipt plumbing must implement the prose rule under the existing scoped protocol; no broader rejection-completeness claim is approved.
implementation_requirements: Run six exact-three-hash approvals and two clean registered proof builds before activating the new guard.
Test server/browser interleaved-order rejection, grouped multi-owner and empty acceptance, explicit UI regrouping on owner reassignment and unchanged within-owner ordering.
Test shuffled nodes registry with identical ordered forest produces equivalent source projection, and old receipt replay/collision/auth-denial remain available for an unordered current candidate.
Do not silently reorder accepted history or submitted complete candidates; UI changes remain explicit draft transitions.
approval_scope: Focused local design amendment approved for formal verification. No runtime proof, G2/G3 closure, canonical semantic expansion or commercial clearance.
